# Tes

> Tes is a comprehensive education platform providing teaching jobs, school management software, safeguarding solutions, and educational resources for schools and educators worldwide.

Tes serves as a global hub for education professionals and institutions, offering an integrated suite of tools for school administration, staff recruitment, student safeguarding, classroom management, and career development. The platform combines job listings, professional development resources, and enterprise software solutions tailored for K-12 schools.

## Key Topics

- School Management Software
- Safeguarding Training
- Classroom Management
- Staff Recruitment
- Parent Engagement
- School Administration
- Teaching Jobs
- CPD Courses
- MyConcern
- Class Charts
- Learning Pathways
- Compliance Tracking
- Educational Resources
- International Schools
- Teacher Tools

## Core Platform

- [Tes - Education Jobs, Teaching Resources, School Software & Magazine](https://www.tes.com): Tes homepage: education jobs, teaching resources, school software & magazine
- [Teaching Jobs & Education Jobs - Tes Jobs](https://www.tes.com/jobs): Tes Jobs: UK & international teaching job search & career platform
- [School Software Services, Tools & Products | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools): Tes school software services: recruitment, safeguarding, staff management tools

## Safeguarding & Compliance Solutions

- [Tes MyConcern | School Safeguarding Software | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/myconcern): MyConcern: safeguarding software for concern reporting & case management
- [Tes Safeguarding Training | Safeguarding Training for school staff | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/safeguarding-training): Safeguarding Training: 40+ CPD courses for school staff compliance & protection
- [Tes Clarity safeguarding reporting tool for trusts | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/clarity): Clarity: safeguarding reporting tool for trusts with data analytics & insights

## Classroom & Learning Management

- [Tes Class Charts | Classroom Management Software | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/class-charts): Class Charts: classroom management software for seating plans & behavior tracking
- [Tes Learning Pathways | Learning plans | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/learning-pathways): Learning Pathways: personalized learning plans & student progress tracking platform

## School Administration & Operations

- [Tes Engage – School management information system (MIS) | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/engage): Engage: comprehensive school MIS for administration & parent engagement
- [Tes Timetable | School Timetable Software | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/timetabling-edval): Tes Timetable: school scheduling software for complex pupil & teacher timetables
- [Tes Parents' Meetings | Parents evening system | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/parents-meetings): Parents' Meetings: online & in-person parents evening scheduling system
- [Tes Room Booking | School room booking system | Tes](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/room-booking): Room Booking: school resource & facility management system
- [Tes AssetWhere | School asset management software](https://www.tes.com/for-schools/assetwhere): AssetWhere: school asset management & facilities planning software
